output.question: Where can I find Target's latest annual report?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Target Corporation’s latest annual report is its 2025 Annual Report, available on its [Annual Reports and Archive page](https://corporate.target.com/investors/annual/annual-reports-and-archive). You can read it online or download the PDF; it includes the Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026. ([corporate.target.com](https://corporate.target.com/investors/annual/annual-reports-and-archive))
